correctness.rationale: Conditional-on-subtree-size identity E[R_n|S_v=k]=H_{n-k-1}+1/(v-1) follows from uniform external attachments, and exact beta-binomial probabilities sum to n/[k(k+1)] and 1/k. Taking covariance gives the harmonic formula. Strict monotonicity follows by comparison of harmonic tails; uniform expansion for k=O(sqrt n) yields nCov->c^{-2}-1/2 and crossing kappa_n/sqrt n->sqrt2. Finite checks include all 46,233 recursive trees n<=9 and 376,239 rational sign comparisons. No step relies on extrapolation.

value.rationale: Exact mixed dependence of a distinguished root branching statistic and natural fringe subtree-size profile is structural information not supplied by marginal fringe-size laws. The sign flips sharply at sqrt(2n), within the established square-root Poisson regime, and the new limiting covariance profile pinpoints positive/negative associations.
